job.title: Team Assistant - Boutique Finance
job.description:
.

job.title: Data Operations Assistant
job.description:
.

Really fantastic opportunity if you have an interest in data operations.

The Data Operations Assistant will research, process, check and maintain data to support the company’s services and client requirements. The role combines detailed research, database administration, quality control and client support, covering financial data, investment funds, financial instruments, tax-related information and corporate actions.

Previous financial services experience or qualification is desirable but not essential as full training is provided.

Main duties

Research information: Gather and verify information from websites, official documents, company announcements and data providers.

Investigate financial data: Research investment funds, financial instruments, tax information and corporate actions such as dividends, mergers and stock splits.

Process and maintain data: Enter, update and maintain accurate records in internal databases and systems.

Check data quality: Cross-check information, identify errors or gaps, investigate discrepancies and escalate complex issues.

Support clients: Monitor the helpdesk, investigate queries, follow up outstanding requests and provide professional responses within agreed timescales.

Support daily operations: Prioritise work against delivery schedules and deadlines, maintain clear records and suggest process improvements.

On a day to day basis, the Data Operations Assistant will interact with:

Internally

  • Senior Data Analyst, to whom the role reports.
  • Data Operations colleagues and those of their sister company.

Externally

  • Clients - through the helpdesk portal, responding to data queries and information requests.
  • Data providers - companies, fund managers and other organisations, to obtain information, verify facts and resolve discrepancies.

Essential skills and requirements

  • Strong research skills and the ability to interpret and assess information from different sources.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach especially when dealing with large volumes of data.
  • Good analytical, numerical and problem-solving skills.
  • Initiative and persistence when investigating discrepancies or missing information.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Strong organisation, prioritisation and deadline management.
  • Willingness to learn new systems, processes and terminology.
  • The ability to work independently while recognising when guidance is needed.

Benefits

  • Hybrid working with at least 2 dpw in the office - city based
  • 25 days of Annual leave increasing with length of service to 29 days
  • Buy additional Annual leave scheme – up to 5 days
  • Birthday, Wedding/Civil Partnership, Volunteering days off
  • Life Insurance (Death in Service)
  • Private health insurance with AXA for you and eligible family members
  • Employer pension contributions – 6%
  • Cycle Scheme, Home and Tech Scheme, Octopus EV scheme

job.title: Reg Ops & Oversight Analyst
job.description:
Regulatory Operations & Oversight Analyst


£300 per day | 12-month contract | City of London


We are currently recruiting for a Regulatory Operations & Oversight Analyst to join a leading financial services organisation on an initial 12-month contract, based in the City of London.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Regulatory Operations or Middle Office professional to take ownership of daily EMIR and SFTR oversight controls, support regulatory reporting activities and contribute to wider regulatory change initiatives.
Working within the European Regulatory Operations team, you will play an important role in ensuring the accuracy and effectiveness of regulatory reporting, overseeing third-party providers and identifying opportunities to strengthen operational processes and controls.

The role


  • Perform daily EMIR and SFTR oversight controls, covering trade, valuation and collateral reporting to Trade Repositories, including DTCC.

  • Monitor and investigate reporting exceptions, ensuring errors and discrepancies are resolved promptly.

  • Oversee EMIR delegated reporting arrangements with third-party providers.

  • Conduct EMIR pairing and matching controls.

  • Produce and monitor operational KPIs, identifying trends and areas for improvement.

  • Review existing processes, identify control weaknesses and recommend enhancements to mitigate operational risk.

  • Investigate recurring issues, establish root causes and implement practical solutions.

  • Manage relationships with external service providers, including performance monitoring and service reviews.

  • Draft and maintain operational procedures and control documentation.

  • Act as a subject matter expert on regulatory projects, supporting the implementation of new processes and operational change.

  • Coordinate multiple initiatives, facilitate workshops and work closely with Operations, Portfolio Management, IT, Legal and other stakeholders.

About you


We are keen to hear from candidates with:


  • Around 2–3 years' experience in Middle Office, Investment Operations or Regulatory Operations.

  • Practical experience with EMIR and/or SFTR regulatory reporting, ideally within an asset management environment.

  • Exposure to OTC derivatives, Exchange-Traded Derivatives (ETD), central clearing and/or collateral management.

  • Understanding of Trade Repository reporting, delegated reporting, pairing and matching, and exception management.

  • Experience supporting regulatory change, operational projects or process improvement initiatives.

  • Familiarity with Agile project management methodologies.

  • Strong analytical, technical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

  • A proactive, organised and solutions-focused approach.

  • Fluent English; additional European languages would be advantageous.

Interested?


If you have experience in EMIR/SFTR reporting, regulatory operations or derivatives middle office and are looking for your next contract opportunity, we would be keen to hear from you.

job.title: Portfolio Manager - Specialist Mortgages
job.description:
.

Portfolio Manager – Bridging Finance & Specialist Mortgages

Location: London
Salary: £55-£60K
Working Pattern: Hybrid – 50% office / 50% home
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9.00am – 5.30pm

The Opportunity

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Portfolio Manager to join a growing specialist bank within its Bridging Finance and Specialist Mortgages divisions.

This is a varied, relationship-led role where you will take ownership of an allocated portfolio of customer accounts, acting as the key point of contact for brokers, borrowers and internal stakeholders.

You will play an important role in managing the ongoing servicing of facilities, assessing requests for changes to existing lending arrangements and ensuring accounts are effectively monitored throughout their life cycle.

Working closely with Underwriting, Credit and Risk teams, you will help deliver commercially sound decisions while maintaining excellent customer service and strong risk management standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage an allocated portfolio of customer accounts, acting as the primary contact for brokers, borrowers and internal stakeholders.

  • Handle requests for variations to existing lending facilities, including loan extensions, consents to lease and partial releases of security.

  • Assess customer requests, review supporting information and prepare credit proposals for consideration and approval.

  • Manage a pipeline of enquiries, ensuring requests are progressed efficiently and customers are kept updated throughout.

  • Monitor account performance, identify early warning indicators and escalate potential risks where appropriate.

  • Review facilities approaching maturity, proactively managing repayment plans and considering short-term extensions where appropriate.

  • Liaise with Underwriting, Credit, Risk and Compliance to ensure decisions are made in line with lending policies and procedures.

  • Produce customer documentation, including redemption statements, and maintain accurate records across internal systems.

  • Work towards developing and maintaining an appropriate decision-making mandate.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience in portfolio management, loan servicing or relationship management within financial services.

  • Ideally, exposure to bridging finance, specialist mortgages, buy-to-let or property lending.

  • An understanding of credit risk, lending criteria and the management of secured lending facilities.

  • Experience reviewing customer information and preparing credit papers or proposals.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to assess information, identify potential risks and make recommendations.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to liaise with brokers, customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Highly organised, detail-oriented and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • A proactive approach, with a strong sense of ownership and a commitment to delivering excellent customer outcomes.

Why Join?

You'll be joining a specialist banking environment with an established presence in the property finance market and ambitious growth plans.

The business prides itself on its specialist expertise, strong broker relationships and ability to provide flexible lending solutions to professional property investors and landlords.

This is an excellent opportunity to develop your portfolio management and credit experience within a growing specialist lending operation.
